title: Under durationPolicy perTick a shorter duration mid-run finishes the recipe at once
source: run/TESTING.md §6 タイミング `durationPolicy: perTick` で進捗バーが飛ぶ; docs/jp/structures/JSON_FORMAT.md durationPolicy (perTick re-evaluates every tick; CAUTION: once the value drops below the work already done the recipe completes); docs/jp/recipes/EXPRESSION_REFERENCE.md §5 評価タイミング `duration` (line 311); count_blocks lags up to 20 ticks (EXPRESSION_REFERENCE.md 周囲を調べる関数, docs/en/recipes/CONDITIONS.md §5 Tips). Gold at t=40 is read by t=60 at the latest; by then 40+ work is done, so the 40-tick duration completes the recipe by t=80 (within 40 ticks of the gold) instead of t≈400

title: Under durationPolicy onStart the same recipe keeps its 400-tick duration after gold arrives
source: run/TESTING.md §6 タイミング `durationPolicy: perTick` で進捗バーが飛ぶ (control); docs/jp/structures/JSON_FORMAT.md durationPolicy (onStart evaluates once at the start and keeps it for the run); docs/jp/recipes/EXPRESSION_REFERENCE.md §5 評価タイミング `duration` (line 311). Progress stays on the 400-tick line: ~0.075 at t=30, ~0.25 at t=100, and nothing is output by t=110

title: conditionPolicy abort drops the running recipe when its condition breaks, and the consumed input is gone
source: run/TESTING.md §6 タイミング `conditionPolicy: abort` で稼働中に条件が崩れたとき; docs/jp/machinery/MACHINE_CONDITIONS.md §2 稼働中に条件が崩れたとき（`conditionPolicy`） (abort: the recipe is discarded, consumed inputs are not returned); docs/jp/recipes/CONDITIONS.md (conditions are checked every tick while running); docs/jp/recipes/JSON_FORMAT.md conditionPolicy. The offset block condition is not one of the cached world reads, so it breaks on the tick after the gold goes. Of 2 sand, the one consumed at the start is not refunded and the second cannot start without the gold. The gold is set at t=0 and the input inserted at t=1, so the first search already sees the condition met

title: conditionPolicy pause holds the progress while the condition is broken and resumes from there
source: run/TESTING.md §6 タイミング `conditionPolicy: abort` で稼働中に条件が崩れたとき (pause as the control); docs/jp/machinery/MACHINE_CONDITIONS.md §2 稼働中に条件が崩れたとき（`conditionPolicy`） (pause: resumes where it left off when the condition returns, nothing is lost); docs/jp/recipes/CONDITIONS.md. Gold goes at t=30 and returns at t=60: progress stays near 0.3 meanwhile, and the 100-tick recipe finishes around t=130. The gold is set at t=0 and the input inserted at t=1, so the first search already sees the condition met
